is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae, Anopheles coluzzii, and Anopheles arabiensis (page 3, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotype frequencies for kdr-L995F and ACE-1 (page 6, Figure 1B).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 1B provides pie charts showing the frequency of kdr-L995F genotypes (LL, LF, FF) for different populations, with total sample sizes (e.g., Total=15, Total=16) provided under each chart.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-caught mosquitoes from Tiefora, Burkina Faso and Bahirdar, Ethiopia (page 5, 10).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research article reporting original 16S sequencing and RNAseq data (page 1, 4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites as Tiefora, Burkina Faso and Bahirdar, Ethiopia (page 10).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections were carried out from 7th July to 2nd August 2021 in Burkina Faso and from 28th July to 6th August 2021 in Ethiopia (page 10).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections and experiments.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in Figure 1B.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the microbiome composition and transcriptomic profiles of insecticide-resistant Anopheles mosquitoes from Burkina Faso and Ethiopia. It reports kdr-L995F and ACE-1 genotype frequencies in field-caught populations and links microbiome diversity to insecticide resistance in An. arabiensis from Ethiopia.
